# __Copyediting__

Precision correction of grammar, syntax, and consistency across your entire manuscript\.

### __Key Outcomes__

- Grammar, syntax, and punctuation corrected throughout the manuscript
- A consistent house style applied to spelling, hyphenation, capitalization, and numerals
- Continuity checks — character names, timelines, and facts verified for consistency
- Formatting consistency across headings, dialogue, and citations
- A style sheet documenting every decision, for reference by future editors or proofreaders
- A manuscript that's mechanically clean and ready for design or proofreading

### __Quick Answer__

__Q: How does your Copyediting service work?__

A copyeditor works through your manuscript line by line correcting grammar, syntax, and punctuation, and applying a consistent style, spelling, capitalization, numerals, and formatting, based on a recognized style guide such as Chicago or AP\. You receive the manuscript with tracked changes and a style sheet documenting every consistency decision made along the way\.

### __Market Thesis & Impact__

Copyediting is the stage readers punish hardest when it's skipped\. A structurally strong, well\-written manuscript still loses credibility fast if a reader hits inconsistent spelling, a character's eye color changing between chapters, or a comma splice on the first page\. These errors don't just look unpolished, they signal to readers and reviewers that the book wasn't professionally produced, which affects reviews, word of mouth, and how the book is received in its category\.

Copyediting comes after [line and substantive editing](https://www.kandledirectpublishing.com/services/substantive-editing), once the prose itself is finished being shaped\. Running copyediting too early means correcting sentences that may still be rewritten, so we sequence it as the mechanical pass after the creative and structural work is locked in\.

### __Operational Protocol__

__1\. __Manuscript intake & style guide selection — you submit your manuscript and we confirm which style guide to follow \(Chicago, AP, or a custom house style\)\.

__2\. __Line\-by\-line correction — your copyeditor works through the full manuscript correcting grammar, syntax, punctuation, and spelling\.

__3\. __Consistency & continuity pass — names, timelines, formatting, and terminology are checked for consistency throughout\.

__4\. __Style sheet delivery — you receive a style sheet documenting every consistency decision, useful for future editors, translators, or sequels\.

__5\. __Query resolution — a defined window to review tracked changes and resolve any editor queries before the manuscript is finalized\.

### __Scale Strategy__

Copyediting protects the credibility of everything else you've invested in the manuscript\. Our objective is a text that reads as professionally produced from the first page to the last\. That means:

- __Applying one consistent style throughout__ so nothing reads as amateur or inconsistent
- __Documenting every decision in a style sheet__ so consistency holds across future books, sequels, or translations
- __Sequencing correctly after creative editing__ so we're not correcting text that's still being rewritten
- __Preparing the manuscript for design and proofreading__ with a mechanically clean text ready for the next stage

### __Why Choose Us__

- __Style Guide Expertise__ — editors fluent in Chicago, AP, and custom house styles
- __Full Continuity Checking__ — names, timelines, and facts verified, not just grammar
- __Style Sheet Included__ — a reference document that carries consistency into future work
- __Full\-Service Publisher__ — copyediting connects directly into our line editing, proofreading, and launch services

### __Who This Is For__

- Authors whose manuscript has been through developmental and line editing and is ready for a mechanical pass
- Authors self\-publishing who want a professionally clean, error\-free final manuscript
- Authors preparing a manuscript for a publisher or agent submission where polish matters
- Authors working on a series who need consistency documented for future books

### __Frequently Asked Questions__

__How is this different from line editing?__

Line editing shapes how the prose reads, clarity, flow, and voice\. Copyediting corrects the mechanics, grammar, punctuation, spelling, and consistency, once that prose is finished\.

__How is this different from proofreading?__

Copyediting happens before final formatting and catches grammar, consistency, and style issues throughout the manuscript\. Proofreading is the final check after formatting, catching anything introduced during layout\.

__How long does it take?__

Most copyediting projects take 2\-4 weeks depending on manuscript length\.

__Which style guide do you use?__

We typically work with Chicago Manual of Style or AP style, and can follow a custom house style if you have one\.

__What do I receive at the end?__

A corrected manuscript with all changes tracked, plus a style sheet documenting spelling, formatting, and consistency decisions made throughout\.

### __Ready to get started?__

Developmental editing is the stage most authors skip or shortcut, and it's usually the reason a book underperforms after publication\. Line editing polishes sentences, but if the story sags in the middle or an argument loses its thread by chapter six, no amount of sentence\-level polish fixes that\. Developmental editing addresses the manuscript at the structural level first, so every later editing pass is working on a book that already holds together\.

For authors who've already been through a [manuscript assessment](https://www.kandledirectpublishing.com/services/manuscript-assessment), developmental editing is often the natural next step, the assessment identifies what's structurally weak, and developmental editing works through the manuscript to actually fix it, scene by scene or section by section\.

__1\. __Manuscript intake & editor match — you submit your complete manuscript and we match it with a developmental editor experienced in your genre or category\.

__2\. __Full structural read — your editor reads the entire manuscript, tracking structure, pacing, character or argument development, and consistency throughout\.

__3\. __Editorial letter & chapter notes — you receive a comprehensive editorial letter covering big\-picture issues, plus in\-manuscript notes flagging specific scenes or sections\.

__4\. __Revision support — a defined window for follow\-up questions as you work through the revision, so you're not left interpreting notes alone\.

__5\. __Follow\-up read \(optional\) — a second structural pass once revisions are complete, to confirm the fixes landed before you move into line editing\.

### __Scale Strategy__

Developmental editing sets the ceiling for everything that comes after it\. Our objective is to get the manuscript's structure right once, so later editing stages and eventual launch aren't fighting a foundational problem\. That means:

- __Fixing structure before prose__ so line editing later polishes a book that already works, not one still being figured out
- __Prioritizing revision notes by impact__ so authors tackle the changes that matter most first
- __Building editorial letters authors can act on independently__ not just a list of problems with no path to a fix
- __Connecting into assessment and editing services__ so the manuscript moves through a coherent process instead of disconnected passes

- __Structure\-First Approach__ — we fix the foundation before anyone touches a sentence
- __Genre\-Matched Editors__ — editors experienced in your specific genre or nonfiction category
- __Editorial Letter Plus Margin Notes__ — big\-picture guidance and chapter\-specific detail, not one or the other
- __Full\-Service Publisher__ — developmental editing connects directly into our assessment, coaching, and launch services

### __Who This Is For__

- Authors who've completed a manuscript assessment and are ready to act on the findings
- Fiction authors whose plot, pacing, or character arcs feel unresolved or inconsistent
- Nonfiction authors whose argument loses focus or momentum partway through the book
- Authors preparing a manuscript for agent submission or self\-publication who want it structurally solid first

### __Frequently Asked Questions__

__How is this different from a manuscript assessment?__

An assessment identifies structural issues and gives you a roadmap\. Developmental editing goes further, an editor works through the manuscript with you to actually resolve those issues at the structural level\.

### __Market Thesis & Impact__

Most manuscripts don't stall because the author lacks talent, they stall because there's no outline holding the book together and no accountability keeping momentum going\. Authors start strong and lose the thread by chapter three, or draft an entire manuscript with no structural plan and end up with a book that reads like a collection of ideas rather than a finished work\. Ghostwriting and coaching solve two different sides of that problem, one replaces the writing burden entirely, the other builds the author's own skill and consistency so the book actually gets finished\.

We treat every manuscript as the foundation for what comes after it\. A ghostwritten or coached book that isn't structured around a real [concept and market position](https://www.kandledirectpublishing.com/services/concept-development) is much harder to launch successfully later, so we build manuscripts with the eventual launch and reader in mind from the first outline, not as an afterthought once the draft is finished\.

__2\. __Outline & structure — before any writing happens, we build a chapter\-by\-chapter outline so the book has a clear arc and every chapter earns its place\.

__3\. __Drafting — on the ghostwriting path, chapters are written and delivered in batches for your review\. On the coaching path, you draft each chapter yourself with structured feedback and revision notes after every submission\.

__4\. __Revision & voice\-matching — iterative rounds to make sure the manuscript sounds authentically like you rather than a generic ghostwritten voice\.

__5\. __Editorial pass & handoff — the complete manuscript is reviewed for consistency, pacing, and clarity before final handoff, so what you receive is publish\-ready, not a rough first draft\.

A finished manuscript is only the starting point\. Our objective is to deliver a book you're proud to put your name on and that's structured to perform once it launches\. That means:

- __Building a manuscript authors can actually finish__ and stand behind, not just get through
- __Coaching for skill transfer__ so authors who want it build the confidence and craft to write future books more independently
- __Writing with the eventual launch in mind__ so structure, pacing, and hooks support marketing later instead of fighting it
- __Creating a repeatable process__ for authors planning a series or multiple titles

### __Why Choose Us__

- __Two Engagement Models__ — full ghostwriting or guided coaching, so you get exactly the level of involvement you want

### __Quick Answer__

__Q: How does your Line & Substantive Editing service work?__

A line editor works through your manuscript sentence by sentence, refining clarity, flow, tone, and voice while preserving how you actually sound\. This is different from developmental editing, which addresses structure, this is about how the writing itself reads once the structure is already in place\. You receive an edited manuscript with tracked changes plus notes on recurring patterns worth watching for in future writing\.

### __Market Thesis & Impact__

Readers rarely notice good prose, but they always notice clunky prose\. A manuscript with a strong structure can still lose readers if sentences are repetitive, pacing drags at the line level, or the voice feels inconsistent from chapter to chapter\. Line and substantive editing is where a manuscript stops reading like a draft and starts reading like a finished book, the difference between prose that's technically correct and prose that actually holds a reader's attention\.

This stage only works once the structure underneath it is solid\. If your manuscript hasn't been through [developmental editing](https://www.kandledirectpublishing.com/services/developmental-editing) yet and you suspect there are structural issues, we'll flag that before starting, polishing sentences in a chapter that still needs restructuring wastes your budget\.

### __Operational Protocol__

__1\. __Manuscript intake & editor match — you submit your manuscript and we match it with a line editor suited to your genre and voice\.

__2\. __Sample edit — for longer projects, we edit a sample chapter first so you can confirm the editor's approach matches your voice before the full edit begins\.

__3\. __Full line & substantive pass — your editor works sentence by sentence through the complete manuscript, addressing clarity, flow, tone, and voice consistency\.

__4\. __Tracked changes delivery — you receive the edited manuscript with all changes tracked, so you can review, accept, or query every edit\.

__5\. __Query resolution — a defined window to work through any editor queries or your own follow\-up questions before the manuscript is finalized\.

### __Scale Strategy__

Line editing isn't just about this manuscript, it's about training your ear for prose that reads well\. Our objective is a manuscript that sounds like its best possible version of you\. That means:

- __Preserving your voice__ while sharpening clarity, never smoothing a manuscript into generic prose
- __Flagging recurring patterns__ so you carry the improvement into future writing, not just this one manuscript
- __Sequencing edits correctly__ so line editing happens after structure is confirmed, not before
- __Preparing the manuscript for what's next__ copyediting, proofreading, and eventually launch, with a text that's already reading well

### __Why Choose Us__

- __Voice\-Preserving Edits__ — we sharpen prose without erasing what makes your writing sound like you
- __Sample Edit First__ — confirm fit before committing to a full manuscript edit
- __Tracked\-Changes Transparency__ — every edit is visible and reviewable, nothing is silently rewritten
- __Full\-Service Publisher__ — line editing connects directly into our developmental editing, proofreading, and launch services

- Authors moving out of developmental editing and into the next stage of polish
- Authors who've self\-edited extensively and want a professional pass before proofreading
- Authors who want their natural voice sharpened, not replaced with a generic editorial tone

__How is this different from developmental editing?__

Developmental editing addresses structure, plot, pacing, and argument at the whole\-manuscript level\. Line and substantive editing works at the sentence level, clarity, flow, tone, and voice, once that structure is already in place\.

No\. We edit to sharpen your voice, not replace it\. Every change is tracked so you can see and approve exactly what shifted\.

If your manuscript hasn't been structurally reviewed, we recommend it\. Line editing sentences in a section that still needs restructuring means paying to polish text you may end up cutting\.

### __Quick Answer__

__Q: How does your Proofreading service work?__

A proofreader reviews your fully formatted manuscript, the version laid out for print or ebook, catching typos, formatting inconsistencies, and any errors introduced during design or layout\. ### __Market Thesis & Impact__

Proofreading catches a different category of error than every stage before it\. Layout and formatting introduce their own mistakes, a word dropped during a last\-minute revision, a page number that's off after a chapter was added, a paragraph indent that broke during export, and these slip through even a clean copyedit because they happen after the manuscript was already corrected\. Skipping this step means readers find the errors instead, and in reviews, typos get mentioned far more often than any other flaw\.

This is the last stop before publication, which is why it only happens after [copyediting](https://www.kandledirectpublishing.com/services/copyediting) and once the manuscript is in its final laid\-out form\. Proofreading a manuscript that's still being copyedited means checking a file that's guaranteed to change again\.

### __Operational Protocol__

__1\. __File intake — you submit the final formatted manuscript, print layout or ebook file, along with the copyedited version for reference\.

__2\. __Full proofreading pass — your proofreader reads the complete formatted file, flagging typos, formatting inconsistencies, and layout errors\.

__3\. __Cross\-check against copyedit — the proofread version is compared against the copyedited manuscript to catch anything introduced during layout\.

__4\. __Front and back matter review — table of contents, chapter titles, headers, and any front or back matter are checked for accuracy\.

__5\. __Final sign\-off — you receive a marked\-up copy of every correction and confirmation the file is ready to publish\.
